affinity.notes: The magical rings and suspended objects remain accessories to a materially rendered serpentine figure.

anatomy.notes: Lower coils merge with the dais and the ornate arm-and-apparatus cluster is difficult to parse.

archetype.notes: Ritual sovereign and controller communicates the relic-orbit duty.

counterplay.notes: Raised implements suggest interruptible ritual channeling, and the massive fixed coils communicate low mobility.

finish.notes: Rich jewel-metal finish with consistent ceremonial detail.

identity.notes: Serpentine empress identifies the Naga sovereign form.

tier.notes: Blind reviewer perceived T5; exact intended tier is T5.
